identification: Head of a woman in a dark blue cloak/veil with red scarf, eyes lowered (devotional 'Madonna'-type head after Carlo Dolci / Italian Baroque), oil on canvas, 29 x 21 cm, in a deep ornate gilt composition frame. Back of canvas has a faint ink stamp/inscription (unreadable). Likely late 19th/early 20th C copy.
